newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Santos port says operating 24 hours a day.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Santos port says operating 24 hours a day.

text.p: Brazil's key port of Santos began operating 24 hours a day last week after the port authority signed a deal with operators, a spokeswoman said.
"The port authority Codesp signed a deal with operators on March 24 for the terminal to operate 24 hours a day," the spokeswoman said.
The new system was put into effect immediately and is due to last initially for a trial period of 90 days, she added.
The system is based on six-hour shifts and is one of a series of measures to be implemented under a recent Brazilian port modernisation law.
